findings.note: inventory and assemble independently call _capture_closure/_snapshot_object; captured_at changes and no reviewed inventory or digest is passed to or compared by assemble. A source change after human inspection can therefore be delivered under the same label without approval, and the preview digest recorded in quickstart A cannot equal the assembled inventory digest by design. Bind assembly to the reviewed inventory and refuse any mismatch, or revise the approval contract and evidence path.

The checked tests exercise fixture copies; real-source assembly/verification, boundary and secret sweeps, consumer install/update, docs review, and traceability tasks T029?T030, T033?T034, T036, T039?T042, T044 remain unchecked. The fixture suite does not establish those acceptance outcomes; record the required evidence before asserting the associated SCs.

The spec still states ?Draft ? requirements only; human approval pending? while the current feature state records specify as done and the plan identifies the specify gate as human-approved. Align the status with the actual human gate record; do not imply approval by changing it without the human.
